builds.version: PortMaster package (rolling; retail game version user-supplied)
builds.notes: PortMaster port.json declares aarch64, with launch script/native engine inspected. ARM64 Mono squashfs runs managed Celeste.exe with FNA compatibility libraries. Requires DRM-free original retail files; not x86 translation. Requires PortMaster and applicable native runtime or controller/graphics libraries. NOT tested on Steam Frame; do not assume this package works directly on SteamOS.
